display.$value: "TeX Gyre Heros Cn", "Arial Narrow", "Noto Sans", sans-serif
display.$description: Impactful condensed voice (headings, hero titles). TeX Gyre Heros Condensed — the OSS Arial-Narrow replacement.

interface.$value: "TeX Gyre Heros", Arimo, "Noto Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
interface.$description: The UI sans (Helvetica-Neue aesthetic). Heros is Latin-only via unicode-range; Arimo (metric-compatible) serves Cyrillic/Greek/Hebrew, Noto Sans the rest.

story.$description: The reading serif for long prose. Lora — a warm, variable OFL serif close in spirit to the demo's Georgia (which stays as the metric-adjacent system fallback).

mono.$description: Monospace for indices, durations, code-like labels.

regular.$description: Body weight. The only non-bold weight Heros ships — do not emit 500/600 for the Heros voices (faux-bold).

bold.$description: Bold. Emphasis on the Heros voices is Regular + Bold + tracked uppercase, not a weight ramp.
